title: Upgrade Spend Credit for Northgate Shoppers
content:
A member who has shopped at Northgate over the past year earns an upgrade spend credit when moving a membership of Northgate Memberships to its Plus tier. The credit is taken off the upgrade fee. It is decided from the member's purchase records in Northgate Purchases & Returns.

**Terms.** The member's net Northgate purchases are the merchandise sale lines posted in the twelve months before the upgrade date less the merchandise returns posted in those months, and the purchase lines are the number of those sale lines. A sale line or return falls within the twelve months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its date from the upgrade date.

**Credit.** Net purchases of at least 4000.00 dollars over at least 20 purchase lines earn an upgrade spend credit of 20.00 dollars; net purchases of at least 1500.00 dollars over at least 8 purchase lines earn an upgrade spend credit of 10.00 dollars; anything less earns no upgrade spend credit.

## Both thresholds must be met together

| Net purchases | Purchase lines | Upgrade spend credit |
|---|---|---|
| 4000.00 or more | 20 or more | 20.00 |
| 4000.00 or more | 8 to 19 | 10.00 |
| 1500.00 to 3999.99 | 8 or more | 10.00 |
| 1500.00 or more | fewer than 8 | none |
| below 1500.00 | any | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- Sale lines of 4350.00 over 24 lines, returns of 300.00: net purchases 4050.00 over 24 lines — 20.00.
- Sale lines of 4350.00 over 24 lines, returns of 400.00: net purchases 3950.00 — short of 4000.00, but at least 1500.00 over at least 8 lines — 10.00.
- Net purchases of 5200.00 over 7 lines: fewer than 8 lines — none.
- Net purchases of 1500.00 exactly over 8 lines exactly: both lower thresholds reached — 10.00.
